data.name: Offshore Prophets
data.detailed_description:
After a storm rips their plane from the sky, the survivors awaken on a mist-shrouded island. They must rebuild from the wreckage, harness the island’s strange power, and keep hope alive even as the heavens turn against them.

Features
  • Roguelite City Building - Build and optimize a growing settlement across procedurally generated islands where no two runs are the same.
  • Disasters - Endure apocalyptic storms, quakes, blizzards, and plagues - or exploit them with the right strategy.
  • Efficiency & Spirits - Design perfectly flowing production chains to awaken powerful Spirits that bless your buildings with supernatural power.
  • Synergies - Combine effects to create powerful, run-defining builds.

data.short_description: Carve out a home on a perilous island in this roguelite city builder. Build production chains, discover powerful synergies, and endure catastrophic disasters as each attempt reveals new strategies to survive against the odds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or Direct3D 12 (12_0 feature level) support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or Metal 3 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2018
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
